title: IKEA Recalls Vases Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The base of these vases can break off unexpectedly, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 110,000 nationwide (and about 767,000 more worldwide).

title: Maytag Recalls Dishwashers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Liquid rinse-aid can leak from its dispenser and come into contact with the dishwasher's internal wiring, which can short-circuit and ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2.3 million.

title: Currey & Company Recalls Lamps Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The light socket has a defect, which poses electrical shock and fire hazards. Units: About 2,600.

title: Fisher-Price Recalls "Laugh and Learn" Bunny Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The pink pompom nose can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 500,000 (an additional 700,000 were sold worldwide).

title: Jazwares Inc. Recalls Link-N-Lite™ Magnetic Puzzles, Ingested Magnets Pose Aspiration and Intestinal Hazards
summary: Small magnets used to connect the puzzle pieces can fall out. Magnets found by young children can be swallowed or aspirated. If more than one magnet is swallowed, the magnets can attract each other and cause intestinal perforation or blockage, which can be fatal. Units: About 30,000.

title: Zoeller Pump Co. Recalls Septic Pumps Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The plug on the pumps could have a grounding problem that could pose an electrical shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,300.

title: Basix U.S.A. Recalls Children's Hooded Sweatshirts and Windbreakers with Drawstrings Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The garments have a drawstring through the hood, posing a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 20,000.

title: Battery Packs for Toy Vehicles Recalled by JAKKS Pacific Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The lithium-ion polymer batteries used to charge the toy vehicles can ignite while charging, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 245,000.

title: Samara Brothers Recalls Boys' Jackets Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The snap closures on the outerwear jackets contain excessive amounts of lead, which poses a lead poisoning hazard. Units: About 8,000.

title: Atmel Corp. Recalls to Upgrade Software in Microcontrollers of Honeywell® Digital Cellular Communicators
summary: The microcontroller in the communicator can enter an unrecoverable lock-up state due to a programming issue. The lock-up could result in a service interruption, and fail to transmit an alarm signal in the event of a fire or property invasion. Units: About 4,000.

title: HSN LP Recalls Bella Cucina "Zip Cookers" Due to Burn Hazard
summary: Hot food under pressure can be expelled from the cooker, causing burn injuries. Units: About 8,300.

title: Toddler Pants Sets Sold Exclusively at Meijer Stores Recalled for Choking Hazard
summary: The zipper pull on the jacket can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,800.

title: Children's Bracelets Recalled by DM Merchandising Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The recalled jewelry contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 86,400.

title: Children's Rings Recalled by Shalom International Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The recalled jewelry contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 280,000.

title: Conair Recalls Curling Irons for Shock and Electrocution Hazards
summary: The handle of the curling iron can come apart, exposing its line cord, posing a shock or electrocution hazard to consumers. Units: About 322,000.

title: LL Bean Recalls Infant Booties Due to Choking Hazard
summary: A small metal zipper tab on the infant booties can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 4,400.

title: Easy-Bake Ovens Recalled for Repair Due to Entrapment and Burn Hazards
summary: Young children can insert their hands into the oven's opening and get their hands or fingers caught, posing an entrapment and burn hazard. Units: About 985,000.

title: Pelagic Recalls Digital Dive Computers Due to Decompression Hazard
summary: When performing a switch from one gas to another during a dive, the dive computer's display will lock up and not return to the main dive screen that displays dive times. This can cause divers to enter decompression unknowingly or the diver could ascend prematurely, resulting in decompression sicknes

title: Mirraco Recalls Bicycles Due to Wheel Fork Failure Hazard
summary: The front wheel forks on these bicycles could have been welded improperly. This poses a risk that the weld could fail, and the rider could lose control and fall. Units: About 11,000.

title: Sportcraft Recalls Inflatable Bounce Houses Due to Impact Injury Hazard
summary: The fan and the plastic housing surrounding the fan can break apart during use of the inflatable bounce house, posing a risk of impact injury to consumers. Units: About 2,600.

title: Children's Jewelry Sold Exclusively at Kmart Recalled by Crimzon Rose Accessories Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The recalled jewelry contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 6,000.

title: Children's Rings Sold at Big Lots! Stores Recalled By Lari Jewelry Company Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The recalled jewelry contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 115,000.

title: Best Buy Co. Inc. Recalls Remote Controls Used With Insignia DVD Players Due to Burn Hazard
summary: If the batteries are placed backwards in the remote control with the positive and negative sides improperly switched, overheating can result and present a burn hazard. Units: About 10,000.

title: Gel Candles Recalled By M & A Global Technologies Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The candles can have excessive flame height, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,700.

title: Safety Alert: CFM U.S. Corp. Multi-Purpose Gas Lighters Sold at Wal-Mart Lack Safety Warning Labels
summary: The lighters do not have a label in English containing precautionary information concerning the proper use and operation. Failure to follow the instructions in the warning label could result in injury. Units: About 1.8 million.

title: Tankless Water Heaters Recalled for Repair Due to Carbon Monoxide Poisoning Hazard
summary: Components inside the water heater may shift during transit, causing an air filter door switch to operate improperly. title: Tap Machine Inc. Recalls Sake Warmers Due to Burn Hazard
summary: These sake warmers can unexpectedly spray hot sake on consumers during use, posing a risk of serious burns. Units: About 2,000.
